answer: The whole-space lint never runs on its own because it's expensive. It runs `space.lint` over every page, reads each page, runs every lint rule and renders its `${…}` expressions and Lua widgets. On a large space that can take a while, so you start it yourself by pressing **Run space-wide lint**. The source is `Workbench/Maintenance.md`.

16:# Space-wide lint
17:The space-wide lint runs [[API/space#space.lint]] over every page. This reads each page, runs every lint rule and renders its `${…}` expressions and Lua widgets, so on a large space it can take a while. That’s why it never runs by itself: press **Run space-wide lint** when you want it.
